auditPersonalData.reason: Pending complete aggregate-reference closure for accepted legacy IDs or missing subjects. Account membership selects workspace, but users/subjectID canonical presence is not enforced by the record schema. Missing subject plus matching omitted ContentData changes audit enrichment.
auditPersonalData.temperatureReason: Administrative, setup, onboarding, privacy, import/export or rare maintenance operation outside the owner's active-user hot-path set. Static classification; the single load profile overrides this if observed.

eraseMember.reason: Legacy mode reads WorkspaceMetadata. Bounded mode takes only the installed core Workspace.ID through eraseMemberWorkspaceID. For a target without a membership row, the former-member read uses BeginFormerMembersRead, retains the handle through every map use, and refuses the write on a failed directory read. erasure covers identity selection and successful legacy erasure. The bounded writer remains pending at erasePersonInWorkspace.

refuseSoleAdmin.reason: The existing field accessor requests only workspace identity, which remains resident under the process policy cap. SoleAdminWorkspaces supplies authoritative ownership; no member/body collection is loaded. TestScaleCoreReadsDifferential compares the refusal body across principal and credential classes, including users from another workspace.
